Tabata 20 seconds on - 10 seconds off x 5 mins (00:00)
Hollow & Arch Hold
T2B
T2B Bar Progression
1-2 mins False Grip on bar - focus on Knuckles Up (6:00)
EMOM x 2 (9:00)
10 x Beat Swing
EMOM x 2 (11:00)
Bigger Beat Swing - Push Down on Bar
Reach Long in the Arch not back - Dont bend the knees
EMOM x 2 (13:00)
Knees to Chest - Aggressive & Pop - pause at the top
EMOM x 3 (15:00)
Aggressive Knees to chest - with toe flick
EMOM x 2 (T2B Attempt) (18:00-20:00)
While Maintaining Tight Shapes
Level 1: Knees to chest/elbows
Level 2: 1-2 Toes to bar
level 3: 10+ toes to bar
Level 2: Work with a partner and pick a target you can aim for while maintaining tension
Level 3: Practice Hollow & Arch Shapes then Max reps as an E2MOM
ROW Technique - work with a partner
3 minutes
Stroke Sequence
Extend Legs then Hips then Arms
Reverse on recovery
- keep body between 10 & 2 don't lean too far forward or back
30 seconds on - 30 seconds off x 3
Row aiming for 20-24 strokes per minute
generate power then recover
then 500m row - focusing on good technique - do in 2 heats

hypertrophy.reasoning: Today emphasizes shoulder stability, lats, and core via gymnastics; horizontal pulling and posterior chain provide balance without interference.
